title: A dream kept within
odia:
ଘୁଙ୍ଗା ଯାହା ସପନ ଦେଖେ
ମନ କଥା ମନରେ ରଖେ।
literal_meaning: Whatever a person unable to speak dreams, they keep the thoughts within their mind.
meaning_odia: କଥା କହିପାରୁନଥିବା ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ସପନରେ ଯାହା ଦେଖନ୍ତି, ତାହା ମନରେ ରଖନ୍ତି—ଏହା ପଦ୍ୟର ଚିତ୍ର। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ମନରେ ଥିବା ଅନୁଭବ କଥାରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ ନହୋଇ ନିଜ ଭିତରେ ରହିଯିବା ଏହାର ଭାବ।
explanation: The dream is experienced inwardly and remains unspoken in the scene the proverb presents. Our editorial reading focuses on that gap between having an experience and putting it into words. The image gives form to a thought or feeling that stays with its bearer.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A vivid experience matters deeply to someone, but they find no words for it in conversation. A reader recalls the couplet as an image of what remains unspoken.
cultural_context: ସପନ supplies an inward event that others cannot directly see. The repeated ମନ holds the second line inside that same private space. The verse’s use of ଘୁଙ୍ଗା belongs to its figurative scene; the commentary concerns unspoken experience.
